def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    cars = image_patch.find("car")
    buildings = image_patch.find("building")
    
    if not cars or not buildings:
        return image_patch
    
    cars_on_right = [car for car in cars if car.horizontal_center > image_patch.width / 2]
    buildings_on_left = [building for building in buildings if building.horizontal_center < image_patch.width / 2]
    
    if not cars_on_right or not buildings_on_left:
        return image_patch
    
    closest_building = min(buildings_on_left, key=lambda b: abs(b.horizontal_center - image_patch.width / 2))
    cars_near_building = [car for car in cars_on_right if abs(car.horizontal_center - closest_building.horizontal_center) < 100]
    
    return cars_near_building
